definitions.explanation: water escaping from pipes, tanks, or other containers

examples.japanese: {水漏|みずも}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦{洗面台|せんめんだい}→洗面台：04988_senmendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{水漏|みずも}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}した→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧。
examples.english: I found a water leak under the sink.

examples.japanese: {水漏|みずも}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}した→依頼する：21376_irai⟧。
examples.english: I asked a contractor to repair the water leak.

notes:
{水漏|みずも}れ means water leaking from pipes, faucets, or appliances (⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ water + ⟦{漏|も}れ→漏れ：13362_more⟧ leak).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {水漏|みずも}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a water leak occurs
- {水漏|みずも}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to repair a water leak

COMMON LOCATIONS: ⟦{水道管|すいどうかん}→水道管：08094_suidoukan⟧ (pipes), ⟦{蛇口|じゃぐち}→蛇口：04218_jaguchi⟧ (faucet), ⟦{洗面台|せんめんだい}→洗面台：04988_senmendai⟧ (sink), ⟦{給湯器|きゅうとうき}→給湯器：04904_kyuutouki⟧ (water heater).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{雨漏|あまも}り→雨漏り：07935_amamori⟧: roof leak (rain, not plumbing)
- ⟦{漏電|ろうでん}→漏電：07965_rouden⟧: electrical leak, not water
- ⟦{漏水|ろうすい}→漏水：24073_rousui⟧: more formal/technical synonym

WATCH OUT: In a Japanese apartment, report a leak to the ⟦{管理会社|かんりがいしゃ}→管理会社：23531_kanrigaisha⟧ (management company) or ⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧ (landlord) right away — leaks often affect neighbors below.

REGISTER: Neutral; common in everyday conversation.
